Every case a JSON reader can get wrong, in one document: an empty key, a key holding a quote, a colon, a dot and a line break, null, a nested list holding an empty list, an empty map and an empty list, a float with an exponent, and a string with a quote, a backslash, a tab and a line break. Its keys are in canonical order, so reading it into SILT and writing it back gives the same bytes.
